dialogue_script.speaker: Man
dialogue_script.text: Hi young lady. How may I help you?

dialogue_script.speaker: Girl
dialogue_script.text: Well... yeah. I’m looking for a Father’s Day gift.

dialogue_script.speaker: Man
dialogue_script.text: OK. How about getting your father a new shirt?

dialogue_script.speaker: Girl
dialogue_script.text: He’s tall with broad shoulders and hmm…I think he is getting a little overweight now.

dialogue_script.speaker: Man
dialogue_script.text: Extra large, then. Look at this black one. Do you think it fits him?

dialogue_script.speaker: Girl
dialogue_script.text: That’s all right but the colour doesn’t suit him. He’s rather dark. I think the striped one suits him better. How much is it, anyway?

dialogue_script.speaker: Girl
dialogue_script.text: Huh? That’s too expensive for me. Do you have something cheaper?

dialogue_script.speaker: Man
dialogue_script.text: Hmm. How about this green T-shirt? It’s pure cotton.

dialogue_script.speaker: Girl
dialogue_script.text: Umm...it feels so soft and I think my father likes this design. It matches his linen jacket, but the price tag says $13.99, and I know I don’t have that much money. I only have $12, 00.

dialogue_script.speaker: Man
dialogue_script.text: Well, let me see… You’re lucky. This T-shirt just went on sale. It’s only $11.90. What do you say?
